scoring_justification: The scan is fully recomputed by fitting a spline to the agent's angle-energy table and extracting minima positions and energy difference. The three scalar properties are directly compared to the paper's reported O3 values with tolerances; these are fixed deterministic simulation outputs, so a result-level comparison is acceptable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for proton out-of-plane scan minima positions and energy difference, and for deprotonation energy, O-H vibrational frequency, and ammonia adsorption energy on the O3 acid site.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (deprotonation energy 1174.6 kJ/mol, O-H vibrational frequency 3514 cm⁻¹; O3), Table 4 (ammonia adsorption energy on O3 144.5 kJ/mol), and Fig. 3 caption/text (scan minima at 35.7° and −39.5° with ΔE ≈ 6.30 kJ/mol).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the published paper values for chabazite with 1 Al/unit cell and proton on O3.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the study and serve as the verification standard for a correct reproduction.

outputs.description: Potential energy scan of the proton out-of-plane angle on the O3 oxygen. The checker will fit a cubic spline to the energy curve, locate the two local minima, and compare their angles and the energy difference to the paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances.

Computed deprotonation energy, O–H vibrational stretch frequency, and ammonia adsorption energy for each of the four acid sites O1–O4. The checker compares each site's values to the paper-reported values within tolerances, testing the homogeneity conclusion.

output_contract.notes: The scan artifact remains focused on O3 to identify proton minima. The properties artifact now contains all four acid sites, allowing the verifier to check cross-site comparisons required by the paper's central claims.

steps.description: Fit a cubic spline to the angle–relative-energy table, locate the two local minima (global and metastable) and their energy difference, and compare to the paper-reported values for the O3 site.
Compare deprotonation energy, O-H vibrational frequency, and ammonia adsorption energy to the paper's O3 site values using tolerances.
